book.name: Uibrani
book.title: Ubvur umbɔ aka atsɛnge abi Uibrani

content: Isha, Unum arherhe arherhe nggu atokamɛn ra angwĩ abika asɔm Arherhu-Num ri ivanga irhɛirhɛ ra atsĩndĩã arhɛrhɛ.
Bɔr ri ivang iyiki imimasha iyɛrɛ unga arherhuwa umɛn arherhe ra angwĩ Ungwɛ̃nga. Unga aka atsũ unga awe uner ukam abina kishoo. Ru ubok ungwɛ̃ hã Unum aka amunu upfunga ikɛi.

Ungwɛ̃ hã unga adɛyiwe irhirhang Unum na awe uzirhzĩ Unum, na awu icaica nggu unga. Unga akpɔm abina kishoo ra arherhanga aki ijee. Unga aka amaa igbishu utsĩndĩ uwuku usorhe arhim, unga aseisa ru ubok ugha Uwuku Ugɔnga ra afã.
Nggee unga ananga ípfu itser-Num, rimi hã, itsokyɛ umbɔ aka adzowe unga inangke ikimbɔ.
Awu ipfu itser-Num iyikisong Unum aka ayisa ngge agɛ,
Use ikɛi unga agɔr ngge agɛ,
Nu ikɛi, ivangyɛ Unum aka akũ ukã ungwɛ̃nga aba ru upfung, unga agɔr agɛ,

content.text: <<Uneke kishoo ípfu itser-Num idzowe unga igɔng.>>

content: Arherhi ípfu itser-Num, unga agɔr agɛ,

content.text: <<Unga atsu ípfu itsernga ngge iwe ru nyaku ugba,
na atsu umbɔ awe ru nyaki ikonrha
ri itseryɛ umbɔ aki itɔ̃we unga.>>

content: Bɔr ru Ungwɛ̃nga unga agɔr agɛ,

content.text: nu ungo uwuri ikũ igbong iyiki igha Iyɛrhango
Ungo uku ubemu ubɛn irhirhika nu ukpɛ̃ɔ ubɛn iki ibewe,
nggee, Unumngo aka atsu ungo unango awɛrhango
awu ungo udzin atarh idzin abĩ,
bɔr ungo uwuri iwe umɔ ubɛn ivang.
Umbɔ awuri ishaka ugɛɛ atorho aka agbe.
Ungo uwuri ifeta ake ugɛɛ atorho,
awuri ifara ake ru nyaka umbɔ iki ifaru untama.
Bɔr ungo uwe ru nyaka ungo uku uwe,

content: Ipfu itser-Num iyikisong Unum aka agɔr ngge agɛ,
Bɔr ípfu itser-Num kishoo akpurha awu awɛ itser Unum aka adene ngge iyike abirabɛ aka igha ukam ififɔrh.
